data.body: AC amendment (gap analysis 3/6): Add DSO_SLEEP_CMD override for retry-with-backoff test. Test 8 with literal sleep 2/4/8s burns 6+s wall-clock per run, risking ~73s Bash-tool ceiling under parallel sprint load. Add DSO_SLEEP_CMD env override (default 'sleep'); stub to '/bin/true' in test 8. Mirror task-2: replace literal sleep with "${DSO_SLEEP_CMD:-sleep}" N.
